repeatable_mechanisms: State the agenda or question architecture before entering details.
Use a host or expert role to anchor authority and divide the reasoning workload.
Move from macro conditions to country, industry, company or asset implications.
Challenge headline data through components, revisions, comparisons or mechanism explanations.
Use host recaps to compress long specialist answers into a practical observation.
End major sections with a conditional outlook or a next indicator to watch.
